protocol.loss: L_cls + L_graph + 0.05 L_pair + 0.01 L_adv + 0.01 L_preserve; SCMR balanced O/F and archived guidance/background/boundary terms with archived differential update
protocol.spectrum: CAM240, 8 train-only PCA directions + 8 weighted squared pairwise class covariance contrast directions on PCA complement, 16 whitened tokens
protocol.classes: NC/MCI/AD retained as three conditional Gaussian classes
protocol.gaussian_banks: one global outer-train bank and five inner leave-bank StratifiedKFold banks, seed 824250 + fold, plus historical double-deletion comparison banks
protocol.prompts: canonical E82.4.6-G2 fixed eight-text medical and anonymous embeddings, SHA verified
protocol.gradient_budget: archived apply_budget and optimizer_measurements; four shared parameter families, fp64 tangent to historical gradient and cast-protected 0.001 norm cap
protocol.ema: source observation and advancing class moments; Best uses the exact pre-advance evaluation bank, Latest uses advance for subsequent training
protocol.abide_fold8: not copied; no patient overlap or ABIDE checkpoint is used
protocol.candidate_adaptation: Six historical non-CORR branches. Keep original supported off-diagonal edges, mutual Top-12, 0.55/0.45 thresholds and temperature 1.0. Uniform fixed scale uses historical non-CORR 0.01. Reweight strength 0.8; adaptive gate initialization sigmoid=0.1 and bounded direct residual multiplier 0.02.

warmup.source: TADPOLE E51/E53.3/E61 epoch-10, computed inside each fold

three_class_adaptation.inference: top two native-logit classes oriented AD>MCI>NC, using the same LLR, Jacobian and calibration direction; no outer-test labels
three_class_adaptation.training: balanced over three classes, true-class minus strongest competitor, route pair guidance when the true class belongs to the selected contrast
